name: Audacious Charge
blurb: Active:  Xin Zhao  dashes to the target enemy, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and briefly  slowing them. He then gains  bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

effects.description: Active: Xin Zhao dashes to the target enemy's location, dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies and slowing all targets hit by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Audacious Charge's range is increased against Challenged targets.
Xin Zhao then gains bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.

modifiers.unit: % per 5% bonus attack speed from non-buff sources

effects.description: Three Talon Strike and Crescent Guard can be cast during the dash.

notes:
The primary target cannot dodge Audacious Charge's effects.
The target will always emit the area of effect from their position.
Audacious Charge has a  forgiveness radius of 200 units.
